name: 77072 · Houston, TX
findings: ZIP 77072 (Houston) has 140 nonprofit organizations. 44 of them (31%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 33 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (44% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 77072 (Houston) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.text: 39 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
